notes: Literal registrations only; wildcard semantics and conditional compilation require handler review.
Non-pilot classification is an inventory disposition, not an authorization claim.

Identity/token slice covers the eight enumerated login/config/logout/verify/client-config/scoped-token lifecycle operations. Public operation definitions do not grant access to authenticated personalized discovery. User administration, legacy-key issuance, TOTP challenge completion/enrollment and setup remain later.

Recording-read slice covers nine current UI routes, including play prepare/transcode variants and thumbnails. Timeline manifest/play, files/check and protected-list remain later because the current UI does not call them. Byte ranges are protocol contracts, not JSON payload validation.

Recording-action slice covers twelve protection/retention, tags, deletion, direct download and export-job routes. Retention override is explicitly included by the engineering plan. Job discovery is authenticated; concrete access requires exact creator user and scoped-token identity. Mixed otherwise-valid unauthorized batches fail before mutation/job creation. Operational missing/incomplete/protected failures retain their documented early or partial-result semantics. These jobs expose no cancellation endpoint or cancelled state. Legacy file-path deletion and synchronization remain later.

Session/trusted-device self-service adds four operations: real session/Basic/legacy key owners only, no scoped-token principal. Lists retain the explicit 32-entry cap; revocation and cookie clearing are independent of that cap. IDs are canonical positive safe integers. MFA/password/logout expansion remains pending.

F1d adds MFA completion/enrollment/status, password change and legacy logout. Self-service or effective users.manage discovery; concrete target authorization remains enforced. Seven operations, 44 total. Login and MFA consumers validate responses before claiming success.

F2 covers 13 read/query/preview operations: fleet queries, saved view reads, collection list/detail/members/preview, locations, tags and camera tags. Data remains filtered independently of discovery; mutations are F4. Total 57 operations, 183 residual.
